# Support & Community

We are committed to providing a helpful, accessible environment for users and contributors of NaSuno.

---

## Getting Help

### 1. Documentation

Before asking for assistance, please consult the official documentation:
* [Architecture & System Design](../docs/architecture.md)
* [API Reference](../docs/api-reference.md)
* [Deployment Guide](../docs/deployment.md)
* [Forensic Research & Taxonomy](../docs/research/forensic-taxonomy.md)

### 2. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Review the FAQ section in the [README](../README.md#frequently-asked-questions) for solutions to common issues (e.g., missing audio codecs, DSP performance tuning).

---

## Community Channels

* **GitHub Discussions**: For general questions, feature ideation, audio forensics discussions, and workflow showcases.
* **GitHub Issues**: Reserved exclusively for reproducible bug reports and structured feature proposals adhering to our templates.

---

## Filing an Issue

When opening an issue:
1. Search existing issues to ensure the topic has not already been addressed.
2. Use the appropriate issue template:
   - [Bug Report](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml)
   - [Feature Request](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml)
3. Provide full environment specifications (OS, Python version, installed audio libraries) and minimal reproduction steps.

---

## Security Inquiries

For security vulnerabilities, please refer directly to our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md). Do not submit security reports through public discussion channels.
